ServicesPage.intro: NasLabs helps turn real business needs into reliable web products and systems. Each engagement starts with the problem, not a framework.

backend.title: Backend and API Development

AboutPage.title:
A small studio
with room to think.
AboutPage.intro: NasLabs is an independent software development studio founded and led by Rifki Anashirul (Kinas).
AboutPage.bio1: I'm a software developer and the founder of NasLabs. I graduated from Institut Teknologi Kalimantan with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (S.Kom.).
AboutPage.bio2: My work sits around web applications, business websites, backend systems, and the practical engineering decisions that help software stay useful after it ships.
AboutPage.quote: I started NasLabs to create a space where I can stay close to the problem, make thoughtful engineering decisions, and build software that has a clear reason to exist.
AboutPage.principle1Text: Understand the need before choosing the solution.
AboutPage.principle2Text: Build things that are maintainable after launch.
AboutPage.principle3Text: Keep scope, decisions, and trade-offs visible.
